meaning: How a World Development Indicators series gets its proposed SDG goals: the longest code prefix below that the series code starts with, else the series' own Topic from its World Bank metadata (an exact match after trimming spaces), else no goal. A goal is named only where the SDG global indicator framework (A/RES/71/313 and its annual refinements) has a target or an indicator the series measures or directly informs, and each reason names it. A topic with no goal of its own (population by age and sex, which other indicators use as a denominator) maps to no goal rather than to a stretched one. The goals are a proposal that reviewers read when they attach PublicGoodGrant goals after independent approval; nothing is granted here. The World Bank's own SDG database (source 46, last updated 2022-07-22) lists series without a goal per series, so it cannot replace this table.
